notes.title: Hypnospace Outlaw: Saves & Surprises Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/3cf2f7af669734e0de22962445b263aab0dbf8f3.png

Hi everyone!

We're here to drop you a new update for Hypnospace Outlaw - the saves & surprises update! 

To celebrate, we've got a Steam Daily Deal going for Hypnospace right now, which means you can grab the game for 75% OFF!

We've also got some Slayers X news coming soon - so be sure to keep an eye out when that drops!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/e773ba21e2fa6964859be403cb09fa883b11781b.gif

We've made some changes to Steam Cloud Saves, alongside some cool new stuff in-game too! Here's what you can expect to find:

 Updated the game engine to its most recent version
 Save location migrated for Steam Autocloud cloud-save support, and GlobalSettings save file is no longer synced
 Mod.io API update (they changed their API URL)
 The application window's close button is now captured by HypnOS, so when you click the [x] to close, it will prompt you to log off first
 Two additional people added to credits, we're sorry this took so long!
 New default controller layout for a better experience on Steam Deck

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/2bb8f8f2629f9974acf23c11e5151e48ed3692d0.gif

Here are the in-game changes, spoiler warning if you want these to be a surprise:

 [spoiler] Some changes to QueenOfSanderverse poetry, what shouldn't have been there is now GONE [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] A popular, much loved Hypnospace user can now safely be flagged on any/all days, which could change the outcome of certain things... [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] Hypii is now way more dynamic at the start of the HAP chapter - he might just pick up on the present! [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] HAP page-captured spin animation in the Explorer no longer gets "stuck" [/spoiler]


Thank you all again for keeping the Hypnospace universe in check - it's thanks to you enforcers, that Hypnospace is a safe space free of copyright infringement, harassment, and violations! We'll see you next time!

notes.title: Update: PUBG Mobile's latest skin being renamed to remove reference to Hypnospace Outlaw
notes.notes:
Update: The developers of PUBG Mobile reached out to Hypnospace Outlaw creator Jay Tholen to explain the situation via Twitter. Apparently the skin's original name in Mandarin translates to "Golden Diva" and was designed without Tholen's work in mind. However, "An individual on our localization team saw the visuals for the skin and was reminded of your game. Rather than adopt the literal translation, 'Golden Diva,' the team member decided to change the name to Hypnospace Diva, not considering the consequences or implications of doing so. Those responsible for approving the localization were not familiar with Hypnospace Outlaw, and so were unaware of the name's connection to your game."..
                Read more.

notes.title: Hypnospace Outlaw Modding Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/89807d348fb15d1166892e1a4de2c2aec07abf57.png

Hey everyone,

it's finally here!

The Modding Update for Hypnospace Outlaw is now available to download as a free update, and allows you to create pretty much anything in Hypnospace Outlaw, for other people to download and explore. Accessing mods is as simple as booting the game up, and choosing the Mods option.

But what exactly can you create for Hypnospace? How about:[olist]Webpages
Images and gifs
Wallpapers and screensavers
Music and samples themes
OS Graphical Themes
Soundscapes
Your own zones
Your own cases and stories
Emails
Advertisements
Fonts
Citizens and Characters
Download files
Viruses
Poetry
Stickers
Videos
Custom Scripts and Custom Applications
Player Progression Logic
Chapters
Secrets
Pretty much anything you can imagine
[/olist]
It's entirely possible for someone to create their own full Hypnospace story, complete with new characters, zones, downloads, emails, cases to complete, and horrific viruses and crashes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/6c88bff5f5db4fcad9378b4f993eb48ce1cf1e95.png

So grab the update now, check out some of the mods that have already been created, then head to the guides section to learn how to create your own content for Hypnospace Outlaw!

To celebrate the launch, Hypnospace Outlaw is now 20% off, the lowest price the game has ever been! Make sure you grab it while it's hot!

Thanks all, and we hope you enjoy <3
No More Robots + Tendershoot

notes.title: The Modding Update is coming November 19th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/b4449e9c593eae499c670f03a011b9c008dbcf9d.png

We've been talking about it for a while, and it's finally time to open the floodgates - the Hypnospace Outlaw Modding Update will be launching on November 19th, along with some super cool mods to get you into the mood (anyone fancy some more Seepage?)


Using an in-game menu built especially for Mod.io, you'll be able to download mods you're interested in and give them a whirl. We know we talked about using Steam Workshop previously, but we're excited by the possibilities that Mod.io gives us and we promise it's really easy to use!

We've made sure that come the 19th there'll be some cool things for you to try as well as some guides to get you started, even if you've not modded a game before. If you find you're looking for more help or to collaborate with others, we've also got a channel in the Discord for advice, asking questions and inspirations!

From themes to hacks, music to whole new storylines, this will be a chance to make Hypnospace YOURS, and tell YOUR story, however you'd like! 

We can't WAIT to see what you create - see you on the 19th ;)
